basics.headline: Expert Angular and React Developer. Building Dynamic User Interfaces.
basics.summary:
Senior Frontend Engineer with 8+ years of experience building high-performance, scalable web applications across education, real-time communication, and data-driven platforms.

Strong expertise in React, Next.js, and Angular, with deep focus on component-driven architecture, performance optimization, accessibility (WCAG), SEO, and design systems.

Proven ability to own features end-to-end, mentor engineers, and collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to deliver production-grade user experiences at scale.

responsibilities: Owning and delivering end-to-end frontend features using React, Next.js, and React Native.
Built reusable components and hooks aligned with a shared UI architecture.
Improved SEO and performance through SSR, optimized rendering, and lazy loading.
Collaborated closely with designers and backend engineers to translate UI/UX designs into scalable frontend solutions.
Developed large-scale React and Angular dashboards for teachers and students used by thousands of daily users.
Built real-time React interfaces for video, audio, and chat using WebRTC (Twilio, Agora, Whereby).
Designed reusable UI components and frontend libraries, contributing to design consistency and faster development cycles.
Improved frontend performance by 35% through rendering optimizations, lazy loading, and efficient state management.
Mentored junior engineers, led code reviews, and conducted knowledge-sharing sessions.
Worked in Agile teams, contributing to sprint planning, estimations, and timely milestone delivery.
Built scalable frontend applications using Angular and React for education and trading platforms.
Implemented performance optimizations including code splitting and lazy loading, improving load times by 25%.
Integrated REST APIs and collaborated with backend teams for seamless data flow.
Contributed to mobile deployments using Cordova for Android and iOS.
Developed SPAs using Angular and React, improving engagement and responsiveness.
Built data visualization dashboards using D3.js and Highcharts, reducing page load time by 30%.
Ensured responsive and cross-browser compatible UI implementations.
Developed responsive web and hybrid mobile applications using Angular, Ionic, and Cordova.
Collaborated with designers and backend developers to deliver user-friendly interfaces.

skills: Frontend Frameworks — React, Next.js (SSR, SEO optimization), Angular
State Management & Architecture — Redux, Context API, RxJS, NgRx, Component-driven design
Performance & Optimization — Code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, Web Vitals, Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools
Accessibility & SEO — WCAG, ARIA, semantic HTML, SSR, metadata optimization
Testing & Tooling — Jest, Karma, Jasmine, Webpack, NPM
APIs & Auth — REST APIs, JWT-based authentication
Dev Practices — Agile (Scrum, Kanban), Git, code reviews, documentation
achievements: React-first mindset with strong Angular background
Proven ability to work in remote, cross-functional teams
